name: PCW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top belt, contested for the first time in an eight-man tournament at "One Night in Hollywood," 16 August 1998 — Hale's win is the only reign the surviving record holds.

name: PCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Restricted by the fed's own rule to wrestlers under 235 pounds, first decided in an eight-man gauntlet at "One Night in Hollywood," 16 August 1998, won by Daft Vader — the only reign the surviving record holds.

name: PCW Coastal Championship
epitaph: Billed the fed's own "working man's title," defended most often of its four belts. Colossus won it in a battle royal at "One Night in Hollywood," 16 August 1998; the fed's own rankings page a month later billed Boche as champion instead, a change the surviving record never shows happening.

name: PCW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by the stable the Westside Connection in a four-team ladder match at "One Night in Hollywood," 16 August 1998 — the only reign the surviving record holds. The fed's own schedule page bills a challenge from a team called the Stone Crushers on the "Monday Night Special," 21 September 1998; no result survives.
